name: Rolling Comparison Window
description: Maintains a fixed-size deque of ComparisonPair samples per task type for per-task quality tracking. Each pair includes timestamp, input, local response, remote response, and evaluation score. Supports adding new pairs, computing aggregate correlation (mean of evaluation scores), computing trend (slope of scores over recent N pairs via linear regression), and checking staleness (whether oldest pair exceeds max_window_age). Persists to disk as JSON for survival across restarts. Thread-safe via threading.Lock (lock not held during I/O). Timestamps assigned at insertion time. Empty/insufficient-data cases return None/INSUFFICIENT_DATA rather than raising exceptions. Persistence is triggered explicitly by the caller, not on every add.

types.name: TrendDirection
types.description: Direction of the evaluation score trend over the recent window of comparison pairs.

types.name: ComparisonPair

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: ISO-8601 UTC datetime string indicating when this pair was inserted into the window. Assigned by the window implementation, not caller-provided.

validators.error_message: Timestamp must be an ISO-8601 UTC datetime string ending in +00:00

fields.name: input_data
fields.description: The input prompt or query that was sent to both local and remote models.

validators.error_message: input_data must be a non-empty string

fields.name: local_response
fields.description: The response produced by the local model for the given input.

fields.name: remote_response
fields.description: The response produced by the remote model for the given input.

fields.name: evaluation_score
fields.description: Score from 0.0 to 1.0 (inclusive) representing evaluation quality of the local response relative to the remote response, as determined by a task-specific evaluator.

validators.error_message: evaluation_score must be between 0.0 and 1.0 inclusive

types.description: Immutable (frozen) Pydantic v2 model representing a single comparison sample between local and remote model responses, with an evaluation score. Timestamp is assigned at insertion time by the window, not by the caller.

types.name: ComparisonPairInput

fields.name: input_data
fields.description: The input prompt or query that was sent to both local and remote models.

validators.error_message: input_data must be a non-empty string

fields.name: local_response
fields.description: The response produced by the local model for the given input.

fields.name: remote_response
fields.description: The response produced by the remote model for the given input.

fields.name: evaluation_score
fields.description: Score from 0.0 to 1.0 (inclusive) representing evaluation quality.

validators.error_message: evaluation_score must be between 0.0 and 1.0 inclusive

types.description: Caller-provided data for creating a ComparisonPair. Does not include timestamp — that is assigned at insertion time by the window.

types.name: WindowAggregate

fields.name: mean_score
fields.description: Arithmetic mean of evaluation_score across all pairs in the window. None if the window is empty.

fields.name: trend_slope
fields.description: Slope of the linear regression of evaluation_score over the most recent trend_window pairs (or all pairs if trend_window is None). None if fewer than 2 pairs are available for trend computation. Positive slope indicates improvement, negative indicates degradation.

fields.name: trend_direction
fields.description: Categorical interpretation of trend_slope: IMPROVING if slope > 0, DEGRADING if slope < 0, STABLE if slope == 0, INSUFFICIENT_DATA if fewer than 2 pairs.

fields.name: is_stale
fields.description: True if the window is empty or the oldest pair's timestamp exceeds the configured max_window_age relative to current UTC time. Always true for empty windows (no data = needs samples).

fields.name: sample_count
fields.description: Number of comparison pairs currently in the window.

fields.name: oldest_timestamp
fields.description: ISO-8601 UTC datetime string of the oldest pair in the window, or None if the window is empty.

types.description: Immutable (frozen) Pydantic v2 result model containing aggregate statistics computed from the current contents of a rolling window. Fields that cannot be computed (empty window, insufficient pairs for trend) are None or INSUFFICIENT_DATA.

types.name: ComparisonPairList
types.description: An ordered sequence of ComparisonPair instances, from oldest to newest.

types.name: WindowConfig

fields.name: window_size
fields.description: Maximum number of ComparisonPair samples to retain. When exceeded, the oldest pair is evicted. Default is 100.

validators.error_message: window_size must be between 1 and 10000 inclusive

fields.name: max_window_age_seconds
fields.description: Maximum age in seconds for the oldest pair before the window is considered stale. Used by check_staleness and aggregate. Default is 86400 (24 hours).

types.description: Configuration for constructing a DequeRollingWindow instance.

types.name: StoreConfig

fields.name: base_dir
fields.description: Filesystem directory path where per-task JSON files are stored. Created if it does not exist.

validators.error_message: base_dir must be a non-empty string

functions.name: DequeRollingWindow.__init__
functions.description: Constructs a DequeRollingWindow backed by collections.deque(maxlen=window_size). Accepts a WindowConfig and an injected WindowStore for persistence. Initializes an empty deque and a threading.Lock. Does NOT load persisted state — caller must explicitly call load_from_store if restoration is desired.

inputs.name: store
inputs.description: An injected WindowStore protocol implementation for persistence. Typed as protocol reference (WindowStore). Passed via dependency injection for testability.

postconditions: len(self) == 0 after construction (empty window)
Internal deque has maxlen == config.window_size
Internal threading.Lock is initialized and unlocked

structured_side_effects.description: Pure construction, no I/O or mutation beyond self

functions.name: DequeRollingWindow.add
functions.description: Adds a new ComparisonPair to the rolling window. The caller provides a ComparisonPairInput (without timestamp); the implementation assigns timestamp as datetime.now(timezone.utc) at insertion time. If the deque is at maxlen, the oldest pair is automatically evicted. Acquires threading.Lock for the duration of the deque mutation. Does NOT trigger persistence — caller must explicitly call persist().

inputs.name: pair_input
inputs.description: Caller-provided comparison data without timestamp. Timestamp is assigned internally at insertion time.

postconditions: len(self) <= window_size
len(self) == min(previous_len + 1, window_size)
Returned ComparisonPair has timestamp set to approximately datetime.now(UTC)
Returned ComparisonPair.input_data == pair_input.input_data
Returned ComparisonPair.evaluation_score == pair_input.evaluation_score
The newest pair in the window is the returned ComparisonPair
If window was at capacity, the oldest pair has been evicted

structured_side_effects.description: Appends a new ComparisonPair to the deque under threading.Lock; may evict oldest pair if at capacity

functions.name: DequeRollingWindow.aggregate
functions.description: Computes aggregate statistics over the current window contents. Returns a WindowAggregate with mean_score, trend_slope, trend_direction, is_stale, sample_count, and oldest_timestamp. Trend is computed via statistics.linear_regression over the most recent trend_window pairs (or all pairs if trend_window is None). Staleness is checked against max_window_age_seconds from config. Acquires threading.Lock only to copy pair data, then computes outside the lock. Empty window returns mean_score=None, trend_slope=None, trend_direction=INSUFFICIENT_DATA, is_stale=True, sample_count=0, oldest_timestamp=None.

inputs.name: trend_window
inputs.description: Number of most recent pairs to use for trend (slope) computation. If None, all pairs in the window are used. Must be >= 2 if provided, otherwise trend is INSUFFICIENT_DATA.

error_cases.name: invalid_trend_window
error_cases.condition: trend_window is not None and trend_window < 2

postconditions: result.sample_count == len(self) at time of snapshot
result.mean_score is None if and only if sample_count == 0
result.mean_score is in [0.0, 1.0] if not None
result.trend_slope is None if sample_count < 2 or (trend_window is not None and trend_window > sample_count)
result.trend_direction == INSUFFICIENT_DATA if trend_slope is None
result.trend_direction == IMPROVING if trend_slope is not None and trend_slope > 0
result.trend_direction == DEGRADING if trend_slope is not None and trend_slope < 0
result.trend_direction == STABLE if trend_slope is not None and trend_slope == 0
result.is_stale == True if sample_count == 0
result.oldest_timestamp is None if and only if sample_count == 0

structured_side_effects.description: Read-only computation; acquires lock briefly to snapshot data, no mutation

functions.name: DequeRollingWindow.check_staleness
functions.description: Checks whether the rolling window is stale. A window is stale if it is empty or if the oldest pair's timestamp is older than max_age relative to the current UTC time. Acquires threading.Lock briefly to read the oldest pair.

inputs.name: max_age_seconds
inputs.description: Maximum allowed age in seconds for the oldest pair. If not provided, uses max_window_age_seconds from the WindowConfig supplied at construction.

error_cases.name: invalid_max_age
error_cases.condition: max_age_seconds is not None and max_age_seconds <= 0.0

error_data.message: max_age_seconds must be positive or None

postconditions: Returns True if window is empty
Returns True if oldest pair timestamp < (now_utc - max_age)
Returns False if oldest pair timestamp >= (now_utc - max_age)

functions.name: DequeRollingWindow.pairs
functions.description: Returns a read-only snapshot of all ComparisonPair instances currently in the window, ordered from oldest to newest. Acquires threading.Lock to copy the deque contents, then returns the copy. The returned list is a snapshot — subsequent adds do not affect it.
postconditions: len(result) == len(self) at time of snapshot
result is ordered from oldest (index 0) to newest (index -1)
result is a copy — mutations to result do not affect the window
All elements are frozen ComparisonPair instances

functions.name: DequeRollingWindow.__len__
functions.description: Returns the current number of ComparisonPair instances in the window. Thread-safe — acquires threading.Lock briefly.
postconditions: result >= 0
result <= window_size

functions.name: DequeRollingWindow.persist
functions.description: Persists the current window contents to the injected WindowStore. Acquires threading.Lock to copy pair data, then releases the lock BEFORE performing I/O — the store.save() call happens outside the lock. This is an explicit operation; persistence is not triggered automatically on add(). No-op if no WindowStore was injected at construction.

inputs.name: task_type
inputs.description: Task type identifier used as the key for storing this window's pairs. Must be non-empty.

validators.error_message: task_type must be a non-empty string

error_cases.name: store_write_error
error_cases.condition: The injected WindowStore raises an I/O error during save

postconditions: If a WindowStore is injected, store.save(task_type, pairs_snapshot) has been called with a snapshot of current pairs
The threading.Lock is NOT held during the store.save() I/O operation
If no WindowStore is injected, this is a silent no-op

structured_side_effects.description: Delegates to injected WindowStore.save() outside the threading.Lock

functions.name: DequeRollingWindow.load_from_store
functions.description: Loads persisted ComparisonPair data from the injected WindowStore and replaces the current window contents. Acquires threading.Lock to replace the deque contents after loading. If the store returns more pairs than window_size, only the most recent window_size pairs are retained. No-op if no WindowStore was injected.

inputs.name: task_type
inputs.description: Task type identifier used as the key for loading this window's pairs. Must be non-empty.

validators.error_message: task_type must be a non-empty string

error_cases.name: store_read_error
error_cases.condition: The injected WindowStore raises an I/O error during load

error_cases.name: corrupt_data_recovered
error_cases.condition: The WindowStore encounters corrupt data and returns an empty list with a warning log (graceful fallback)

postconditions: len(self) <= window_size
Returned int == len(self) after load (number of pairs loaded)
If store returned more pairs than window_size, only the most recent window_size are retained
If no WindowStore is injected, returns 0 (no-op)
Pairs are ordered oldest-to-newest in the deque

structured_side_effects.description: Delegates to injected WindowStore.load() to read persisted pairs
Replaces deque contents with loaded pairs under threading.Lock

functions.name: JsonFileWindowStore.__init__
functions.description: Constructs a JsonFileWindowStore that persists ComparisonPair data as JSON files in the specified base directory. Creates the base_dir if it does not exist (using os.makedirs with exist_ok=True).

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Configuration specifying the base directory for JSON file storage.

error_cases.name: permission_denied
error_cases.condition: Cannot create or access base_dir due to filesystem permissions

error_cases.name: invalid_path
error_cases.condition: base_dir is not a valid filesystem path

postconditions: base_dir exists on the filesystem (created if necessary)
Store is ready for save() and load() operations

structured_side_effects.description: Creates base_dir if it does not exist via os.makedirs(exist_ok=True)

functions.name: JsonFileWindowStore.save
functions.description: Persists a sequence of ComparisonPair instances as a JSON file for the given task_type. Uses atomic writes: serializes to a temporary file in the same directory, then atomically replaces the target file via os.replace(). The filename is derived from the task_type with sanitization. Structured logging emitted on success.

inputs.name: task_type
inputs.description: Task type identifier used to derive the JSON filename. Must be non-empty. Sanitized to prevent path traversal.

inputs.name: pairs
inputs.description: Sequence of ComparisonPair instances to persist. May be empty (stores an empty JSON array).

error_cases.name: write_permission_denied
error_cases.condition: Cannot write to base_dir due to filesystem permissions

error_cases.name: disk_full
error_cases.condition: Filesystem has insufficient space to write the JSON file

error_cases.name: serialization_error
error_cases.condition: A ComparisonPair cannot be serialized to JSON (should not occur with valid Pydantic models)

preconditions: All pairs have valid ComparisonPair structure
postconditions: A JSON file at base_dir/{sanitized_task_type}.json contains the serialized pairs
The write was atomic — either the full file is present or the previous version remains
No temporary files remain after successful completion
A structured log entry is emitted recording the save operation

structured_side_effects.description: Atomic write via temp file + os.replace()
Logs save operation details including task_type and pair count

functions.name: JsonFileWindowStore.load
functions.description: Loads a list of ComparisonPair instances from the JSON file for the given task_type. Graceful fallback: if the file is missing, returns an empty list. If the file is corrupt (invalid JSON or schema mismatch), logs a warning and returns an empty list — never raises on corrupt data. Structured logging emitted on fallback events.

inputs.name: task_type
inputs.description: Task type identifier used to derive the JSON filename. Must be non-empty. Sanitized to prevent path traversal.

error_cases.name: read_permission_denied
error_cases.condition: Cannot read from base_dir due to filesystem permissions

postconditions: Returns a list of valid ComparisonPair instances or an empty list
If the file does not exist, returns empty list (no error)
If the file is corrupt JSON, returns empty list and logs a warning
If individual pair entries are invalid, they are skipped and a warning is logged for each
Returned list is ordered as stored (oldest to newest)
All returned ComparisonPair instances pass validation (score in [0,1], non-empty input_data, valid timestamp)

structured_side_effects.description: Logs warnings on missing file, corrupt data, or skipped invalid entries

invariants: The internal deque length never exceeds window_size (enforced by collections.deque(maxlen=window_size))
All ComparisonPair instances are immutable (frozen Pydantic v2 models) — once created, they cannot be modified
ComparisonPair.evaluation_score is always in the range [0.0, 1.0]
ComparisonPair.timestamp is always a valid ISO-8601 UTC datetime string
ComparisonPair.input_data is always a non-empty string
Pairs in the deque are always ordered chronologically from oldest (index 0) to newest (index -1)
The threading.Lock is never held during I/O operations (persistence reads or writes)
Timestamps are assigned at insertion time by the window, not provided by callers
An empty window always reports is_stale=True (no data means samples are needed)
Trend computation requires at least 2 data points; fewer returns INSUFFICIENT_DATA and trend_slope=None
WindowAggregate is an immutable snapshot — it does not update when the window changes after computation
JsonFileWindowStore never raises on corrupt or missing files during load — always falls back to empty list with warning log
JsonFileWindowStore writes are atomic (temp file + os.replace) — no partial writes are visible to readers
No global state — all state flows through constructor parameters and explicit method arguments
All public methods have full type annotations
